name: 五道营胡同
experience_value: Provides a place to slow down and watch contemporary daily Beijing without the pressure of a major attraction.
Useful for solo samples that need browsing, pausing, and small-scale discovery rather than constant headline payoff.
Can soften an otherwise over-scripted route by inserting a lived-in, self-paced segment.
avoid_when: the plan has only one day and needs high-recognition Beijing symbols first
the traveler dislikes cafe, shop, and browse-style exploration
the route already includes multiple similar hutong slow-walk segments
